**Finding: Compliant** (rule LD — liquidated damages/penalties payable by Customer)

The Agreement contains no Customer-payable liquidated damages, penalty, kill fee, or minimum/early-termination charge:

- **§ 6(a)** — either party may terminate for convenience on 15 days' notice when no SOW is outstanding, with no exit payment.
- **§ 6(b)** — on termination for breach, our only payment obligation is fees and expenses "incurred or earned … through the effective date of such termination," i.e. accrued amounts only, not a forward-looking damages sum.
- **§ 3** — compensation is pure time-and-materials per SOW with no minimum spend or committed volume.
- Targeted searches for "liquidated damages", "penalty", "minimum", "cancel", late-payment interest, and "Company shall pay" returned no hits.

This sits at the **preferred** position (no liquidated damages or penalties payable by Customer), not merely the fallback, so no redline was proposed.
